digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text codec and outbound field diff
propositions: State-based echo suppression via baseline diff (current Jira value vs. last-synced baseline) must gate cutover loops where codec is lossy and decode(encode(x))≠x cannot be relied upon.

Two distinct compare paths are required: emit compare uses plain inbound-decoded remote, while baseline compare normalizes the LOCAL side through normalize_outbound to match decode(baseline_wire), preventing spurious "local changed" signals across passes.

The inline binding record must store a change-gated rich_sha counter (rich_reemit) incremented when field emitted with unchanged wire and reset when wire or baseline changes; at threshold=2, one post-push GET advances the baseline via merge_baseline without breaking the sole-writer invariant of _advance_baselines.

Cloud AdfCodec operations repoint to Markdown-aware adf.py functions (markdown_to_adf, adf_to_markdown, normalize_outbound, fit_markdown_to_adf_limit) with lazy optional-extra ImportError fallback to plain-text; DC WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound redefines to decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) restoring codec law, and both DC send sites (_map_local_to_dc_fields and _issues.py) must route through to_wire (render before fit) or ship un-rendered Markdown.

Concurrent both-sides edit keeps rebar local-wins behavior (a713) and raises outbound-field-conflict alert; origin-gating ensures updates fire only when local≠baseline so Jira-authored constructs (panel/mention/date) survive edit-free passes.

Cutover flag (reconciler.rich_text_cutover: off|cloud|dc|both) defaults OFF, enabling per-client opt-in with plain/identity wire fallback on disable, tolerating no-extras install by degrading to plain-text ADF behaviour when marklas import fails.
